title: Photothermal catalysis: a viewpoint from exergy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9302-9311
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01854D, Opinion
Ruoyu Wang, Dong Liu, Qiang Li, Yimin Xuan, Hongguang Jin, Liejin Guo
We shed light, using an exergy balance model, on limiting efficiency, underlying mechanisms, current status and prospective directions for photothermal catalysis, which particularly is not a simple summation of photo- and thermo-catalysis.
